newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tristate says HK$61 mln factory destroyed.
newsitem.headline: Tristate says HK$61 mln factory destroyed.

text.p: Tristate Holdings Ltd said a factory, equipment and fabric at Cavite Export Processing Zone in the Philippines was completely destroyed in a fire occured on April 1, for a loss valued at HK$61 million.

The book value of the factory and equipment was about HK$16 million, and the value of the fabric destroyed was about HK$45 million. The total HK$61 million represents 16.2 percent of the company's net asset value, the statement said.
Tristate said it held insurance cover for the full replacement cost of the factory, the equipment and the fabric, and a claim was being prepared.
The company said the factory produced non-silk wovern garments for the company's U.S. customers and was the company's largest factory in the Philippines.

"At the present time, it is too early to assess the likely impact of the destruction of the factory on the company's turnover and profitability for its financial year ending 31st December, 1997," Tristate said.
